title: A Phenomenology of Neural Geometry in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently geometric, but what shape does the world take inside the policy that performs it? Prior work on vision-language-action (VLA) policies establishes that task-relevant variables are linearly readable from activations, yet readability certifies only that a variable is present and says nothing about the shape its values trace, which may be curved and multi-dimensional. Using controlled sweeps, natural rollouts, linear probes, and activation interventions, we build a taxonomy of seven task-relevant concepts in VLA models. We find that realized geometry is predominantly multi-dimensional and is shaped by the constraints under which the policy acts. Physical joint limits, for example, leave wrist orientation an open arc rather than a circle, and distance to the target, a single scalar, is realized in two orthogonal subspaces, a coarse ruler for the approach and a fine ruler for the grasp. translated_title: 视觉-语言-动作模型中神经几何的现象学研究
translated_abstract: 机器人操作本质上是几何性的，但世界在执行操作的策略内部究竟呈现出什么样的形状？先前关于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的研究已经证实，任务相关变量可以从激活中线性读出，然而可读性只能证明某个变量的存在，却无法说明其取值所描绘的形状——这些形状可能是弯曲的、多维的。通过受控扫描、自然轨迹回放、线性探针和激活干预，我们在VLA模型中构建了七个任务相关概念的分类体系。我们发现，实际呈现的几何结构以多维为主，并由策略行动时所受的约束所塑造。例如，物理关节限制使得手腕姿态呈现为一段开放弧线而非完整圆环；而到目标的距离这一单一标量，则在两个正交子空间中实现——一个是用于接近阶段的粗略标尺，另一个是用于抓取阶段的精细标尺。
tldr: 该论文首次系统刻画了视觉-语言-动作模型内部任务相关概念的真实几何形态，发现其表征以多维、弯曲的形式存在，并由物理约束塑造（如关节限制使手腕姿态呈开放弧线、目标距离以“接近粗标尺”与“抓取细标尺”两个正交子空间编码），从而超越了仅证明变量“线性可读”的先前研究。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a phenomenology of the internal geometry of task-relevant concepts in vision-language-action models, showing that realized representations are predominantly multi-dimensional and shaped by physical constraints—for instance, joint limits render wrist orientation an open arc, and target distance is encoded in two orthogonal subspaces serving as coarse rulers for approach and fine rulers for grasping.
